title: Tape check and question about the Green O bar
summary: After the recorder is fixed, the interviewer asks about the Green O on North Claiborne, which Buddy says he ran on another corner.

blocks.x: Now that looks like it's working fine. I think the little needles are moving. It's moving. Well, yeah, it's moving. It's moving. It has even up. I haven't done this very much. I get nervous about it. I wanted to ask you about the Green O. I know I've seen the Green O over there on North Claiborne Avenue in St. Philip. Oh, yeah. But it's not a bar now. It's a liquor store.
